unlisted_practices: Embed ethical and intellectual property considerations at the design stage of AI systems rather than addressing them retrospectively.
Obtain consent from and share benefits with traditional knowledge holders when their knowledge is used to train commercial AI tools.
Apply Indigenous data governance frameworks such as the CARE Principles to AI development using traditional knowledge.
Design automated summaries and recommendation systems to communicate uncertainty and reflect methodological limitations.
Report data sources used to build AI systems transparently.
Build digital literacy capacity and equitable participation in AI innovation, particularly in low- and middle-income countries.
Ensure human oversight so that AI supports rather than replaces professional judgment.
